entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED UE
entities.description: UE in RRC_CONNECTED state that performs measurements according to network configuration.

entities.name: Cell Measurement
entities.description: Procedure where UE derives measurement results by measuring beams per cell as configured by network.

entities.name: Layer 3 Filtering
entities.description: Filtering applied to cell measurement results before using them for evaluation of reporting criteria, measurement reporting, or conditional reconfiguration execution.

entities.name: Beam Measurement
entities.description: Procedure where UE derives measurement results per beam with beam identifiers as configured by network.

entities.name: measConfig
entities.description: Configuration that triggers UE to perform RSRP and RSRQ measurements for each serving cell.

entities.name: reportConfig
entities.description: Configuration that specifies report type, trigger quantities, and reporting quantities for measurements.

entities.name: measIdList
entities.description: List of measurement identities within VarMeasConfig that associate measObjects with reportConfigs.

entities.name: Trigger Quantities
entities.description: Quantities that trigger measurements including RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, RSCP, EcN0 for cells and SRS-RSRP, CLI-RSSI for CLI measurements.

entities.name: Reporting Quantities
entities.description: Quantities reported in measurements including combinations of RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, RSCP, EcN0 for cells and SRS-RSRP, CLI-RSSI for CLI measurements.

entities.name: Conditional Reconfiguration Execution
entities.description: Procedure where UE evaluates criteria for conditional reconfiguration execution using up to 2 quantities with same RS type.

entities.name: CBR Measurement
entities.description: Procedure where UE performs Channel Busy Ratio measurements without layer 3 filtering.

entities.name: Rx-Tx Time Difference Measurement
entities.description: Procedure where UE performs Rx-Tx time difference measurements without layer 3 filtering.

entities.name: s-MeasureConfig
entities.description: Condition that determines if UE performs measurements based on SpCell RSRP compared to configured threshold.

relations.description: Cell measurement procedure includes layer 3 filtering step for most measurement results.
Beam measurement procedure includes layer 3 beam filtering when beam measurement information is configured.
UE in RRC_CONNECTED state requires measConfig to perform serving cell measurements.
reportConfig contains configuration for trigger quantities like RSRP, RSRQ, SINR.
reportConfig contains configuration for reporting quantities combinations.
Conditional reconfiguration execution requires up to 2 trigger quantities with same RS type.
CBR measurements do not apply layer 3 filtering.
Rx-Tx time difference measurements do not apply layer 3 filtering.
s-MeasureConfig condition determines whether UE performs cell measurements based on SpCell RSRP.
measIdList contains associations between measurement identities and reportConfigs.
